Maya Patel: Heads up — RFC review tomorrow 9:00am PT. Final pass on agenda + who goes when. Authors please confirm you're ready and reviewers shout if you need a different order. Pre-read: https://docs.internal/redwood/rfcs/2026-infer-cache (please add short slides)
Alex Chen: I can cover the model-routing RFC but would prefer it earlier — can we swap the current slot 2 -> slot 1? @Jordan? :eyes:
Jordan Rivera: I have a 9:30 call, earlier works better for me. Swap sounds good. :+1:
Priya Nair: Pre-read done — left comments on the perf section (see the "perf notes" heading). If we swap, can we discuss perf right after the demo?
Samir Gupta: If Jordan gets held up, I can jump in to cover the caching demo Q&A. No problem.
Maya Patel: Proposed agenda (45m):
```
1) Quick intros (2m)
2) Caching RFC — Jordan (10m) + Q&A (8m)
3) Model routing RFC — Alex (10m) + Q&A (8m)
4) Rollouts & metrics — Priya (5m)
```
Alex Chen: Also flagging PR #342 about quantization edge-cases — might belong in the model routing discussion. https://github.com/redwood/rfcs/pull/342
Priya Nair: tiny conflict: I'm on pager duty 8:30-10:00 PT. If Jordan needs earlier, we should move Rollouts to last. Happy to swap.
Maya Patel: OK swapping per Priya. New order posted below. Jordan — can you confirm you can present right at 9:02? @Samir pls have backup notes ready.
```
1) Quick intros (2m)
2) Model routing RFC — Alex (10m) + Q&A (8m)
3) Caching RFC — Jordan (10m) + Q&A (8m)
4) Rollouts & metrics — Priya (5m)
```
reminder-bot: Reminder scheduled: "RFC review — pre-read reminder" will go out at 2026-03-11 08:00 PT to attendees.
Jordan Rivera: :thumbsup: confirmed. I'll highlight the perf regression example and mitigation plan.
Alex Chen: I'll fold PR #342 notes into my slides and call out the quantization tradeoffs.
Samir Gupta: I'll keep the short perf checklist handy (latency numbers, repro steps) in case it's needed.
Maya Patel: Final checklist before the meeting: authors upload slides to the pre-read doc, reviewers react with :eyes: when done, host (me) will update calendar with new order. Thanks all — see you tomorrow 9am PT. :sparkles:
